name: Securities Account Return Criteria 1
definition: Return criteria for information to be returned in the report deriving from a query about securities account reference data.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Indicates whether the identification of the account is requested.

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Indicates whether the identification of the party owning the account is requested.

PartyType.name: Party Type
PartyType.definition: Indicates whether the type of the party owning the account is requested.

AccountServicer.name: Account Servicer
AccountServicer.definition: Indicates whether the account servicer is requested.

AccountType.name: Account Type
AccountType.definition: Indicates whether the account type is requested.

OpeningDate.name: Opening Date
OpeningDate.definition: Indicates whether the opening date for the account is requested.

ClosingDate.name: Closing Date
ClosingDate.definition: Indicates whether the closing date for the account is requested.

EndInvestorFlag.name: End Investor Flag
EndInvestorFlag.definition: Specifies information to identify securities accounts where allocation instructions are posted.

PricingScheme.name: Pricing Scheme
PricingScheme.definition: Defines how the price is applied to the securities account.
